guards.name: decision_gate_supersessions_immutable_replace
guards.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER decision_gate_supersessions_immutable_replace BEFORE INSERT ON decision_gate_supersessions
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decision_gate_supersessions WHERE old_gate_id=NEW.old_gate_id OR new_gate_id=NEW.new_gate_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'STORE_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE: Recorded task decisions and assignment returns are immutable.'); END

guards.name: task_acceptances_immutable_replace
guards.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER task_acceptances_immutable_replace BEFORE INSERT ON task_acceptances
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_acceptances WHERE assignment_id=NEW.assignment_id OR (task_id=NEW.task_id AND decision='accepted' AND NEW.decision='accepted'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'STORE_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE: Recorded task decisions and assignment returns are immutable.'); END
